body.name: Selected-chart confidence-region separation
body.construction: If \(\chi_n=\bot\) or \(\mathcal J_n=\varnothing\), set \(\eta_n=0\). Otherwise compute \(\eta_{n,\chi_n}=\inf_{\zeta\in\mathcal J_n}|\Delta_{\chi_n}(\zeta)|/(1+|\Delta_{\chi_n}(\zeta)|)\) by quantified real algebra and set \(\eta_n=\eta_{n,\chi_n}\).
